Preserve reversible precommit vetoes, conditional compensation, unknown-outcome blocking, current grants, and accepted settlement at close. Retain the released opaque callback contracts. Keep physical shared-store ownership during rewrites and publish filtered committed lifecycle facts so a delayed receipt cannot report an obsolete reset after a successor. Focused caller, native settlement, import, and real Gateway close-order checks pass. Independent Codex review is clean through P2. No schema, retention, durability, configuration, or update migration changes. * fix(scripts): register session executor worker protocols

Reread authoritative rows inside synchronous worker transactions and retain live transaction/commit admission. Preserve legacy catalog adoption and newer-write protection. Join accepted writes during Gateway shutdown and name the next scheduled check or manual refresh command when a background refresh fails.

items.summary: perf(diagnostics): calibrate memory pressure to runtime limits (#165042) Measure main and worker heaps against their actual V8 limits and RSS against host or cgroup capacity. Remove growth-only pressure and fixed byte fallbacks so healthy Gateways retain warm workers. Include measured limits in journal and bundle evidence while keeping critical cleanup asynchronous and Prometheus byte gauges unchanged.
